title: CRT combination of a fixed-point congruence
statement: Let $p, q, m, ed \in \bbn$ with $p$ and $q$ coprime, and write $\bar m$ for the residue class of $m$ in each relevant quotient ring. If $\bar m^{\,ed} = \bar m$ in $\bbz/p\bbz$ and $\bar m^{\,ed} = \bar m$ in $\bbz/q\bbz$, then $\bar m^{\,ed} = \bar m$ in $\bbz/pq\bbz$.
replaced:
The same statement written with the power taken inside the quotient ring: if $p$ and $q$ are
coprime and $\bar m^{\,ed} = \bar m$ in $\bbz/p\bbz$ and in $\bbz/q\bbz$, then
$\bar m^{\,ed} = \bar m$ in $\bbz/pq\bbz$.
